_note: DRAFT for The Völva to rewrite in her own words before launch. Two lines per centre: 'lit' when the week's sky switches a centre on that the chart leaves open, 'open' when it stays open all week. Everything else in Body Weather comes from lib/corpus.json.

Head.lit: Questions arrive with more pressure than usual. Let them stay questions; not every one is yours to answer this week.
Head.open: Other people's questions can feel urgent in your head. Ask whose they are before you chase them.

Ajna.lit: Thought runs in a fixed track for a few days. Use it to decide something, and expect to see it differently once the sky moves on.
Ajna.open: You can hold several views at once. Don't let anyone hurry you into certainty.

Throat.lit: Words come easily and want out. Say the thing that has been waiting, and watch the urge to fill every silence.
Throat.open: You may feel pressure to speak to be seen. Wait to be asked and your words land.

G.lit: Direction feels clear for a while. Take a step along it, and remember the clarity is the week's as much as yours.
G.open: Places and people steer you more than usual. Notice which rooms feel right and trust that.

Heart.lit: Willpower is on loan. Spend it on one promise you can keep, not on proving anything.
Heart.open: Nothing to prove this week. Turn down the promises you'd only make to feel worthy.

Spleen.lit: Instinct speaks quickly and only once. Listen the first time.
Spleen.open: Hold on to what feels good because it's familiar only if it's still good for you.

Solar.lit: Feelings run in a wave for a few days. Let the wave pass before you decide.
Solar.open: You'll feel other people's moods strongly. Step away from a heated room and see what was yours.

Sacral.lit: There's more energy in the body for a while. Give it to work you'd say yes to with your gut.
Sacral.open: Borrowed energy runs out suddenly. Stop before you're spent, not after.

Root.lit: Pressure to get things moving. Use it to start one thing and let the rest wait.
Root.open: Other people's hurry lands in you. You don't have to be free of the pressure to act well.
